page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7t.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached options. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density position this instance as a resource-dense option for workloads requiring significant RAM without the overhead of local storage hardware.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and the absence of local storage or GPU accelerators, the ecs.r7t.16xlarge is designed for memory-intensive workloads. Suitable applications include large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and data processing pipelines that require substantial memory capacity but do not rely on local disk performance.
